issue.title: Commit-stage finalizer latency still above 60s targets on installed publisher
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** commit-stage finalizer: `publication: bead_pages` substep (~38 s median) and the `just fix` before-commit hook (~21 s median), measured on athena host commit `207ded297a` (contains publisher-repair `6d615680b8`).

Repro: run `/tmp/measure_reprove.py` (read-only; evidence at `~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/artifacts/ace-run/202610/30/20261030091257/installed-reprove/`). It re-derives the 73-run no-conflict sample (ancestry check `git merge-base --is-ancestor 6d615680b8 <host_commit>` passes 73/73; 6 exclusions accounted: 2 booted-before-install, 4 conflict repairs, all multi-file, none pin-only), then computes provider_done->done.json from `lifecycle_phases` vs `done.json finished_at`, finalizer-phase from `finalizers/progress.jsonl` phase_started->phase_finished, and per-substep timings from `finalizers/commit/*.steps.jsonl`.

Results (n=73): provider_done->done median 101.3 s, p95 200.6 s (baseline n=54: median 346.5 s, p95 562.1 s — ~3.4x better); phase_started->phase_finished median 92.9 s, p95 177.6 s (baseline finalizer p95 802.9 s); publication total median 38.9 s, p95 95.9 s (baseline publication median 255.4 s), dominated by bead_pages median 38.2 s, p95 95.2 s vs agent_hood_enqueue median 0.6 s; just-fix hook median 21.0 s, p95 30.0 s; create_commit median 2.6 s. Background branch taken by 73/73 runs (commit stdout: `Commit publication selected background enqueue`), 0 inline fallbacks. Publisher queue-age proxy (heartbeat oldest_active) p50 0 s, p95 547.4 s (< 600 s target, passes); heartbeat idle (0 age) 86% of 582 samples; drains 109 published / 30 no_requests / 18 lock_busy / 6 failed / 19 timeout.

Missed targets: model-done->done median 101.3 s vs <60 s (+41.3 s); finalizer-phase p95 ~178-201 s vs <60 s (+118-141 s). Queue-age p95 passes. Recorded as a measured residual per the prove-phase prescription; proposed by bead sase-1pt.9.

- **Impact:** agent commit stages still take ~100 s median instead of the ~60 s target; the residual sits in synchronous commit-stage work (bead_pages page rendering/indexing plus the just-fix hook), not in the backgrounded hood enqueue (0.6 s). Every extra minute of commit stage delays all downstream agent work on athena.
